verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer graphics card, and scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a software automation axis outside a GPU's product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product or its first-party software shipping any job scheduler. The mentions of ComfyUI workflows and G-Assist describe running or tuning things locally, not scheduling recurring runs, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
